statement: Mobeeli (pre-launch parts marketplace / trust infrastructure for Indonesia's $5.3B automotive aftermarket) needs a public marketing website before launch. Today there is no web presence: parts shops invited to the Early Adaptor program have nowhere to register interest, buyers cannot ask to be notified at launch, and investors have no page that explains the product or lets them request the deck. The full design already exists as a reviewed Claude Design prototype (landing page + join-waitlist wizard, EN/ID); it must be turned into a real, deployed website with a working waitlist funnel.
context: Mobeeli launches 2026 in Jakarta. Core product promise: every part verified to fit the buyer's exact car before checkout (120M+ fitment mappings), sellers keep more of every sale (0% platform fee for first 300 shops), and both sides are protected (video-evidence resolution, funds release when the part fits). Pain data: 19.4% return rate on generalist marketplaces, 86% of returns are fitment errors, incumbent seller fees 16.75-19.66% (May 2026 hikes to ~17-20%). Traction: 9 of 14 shops signed in one afternoon pre-launch. The design source of record is the Claude Design project 'Mobeeli Landing Page Design' (copied into .ba/discovery/design-reference/): 'Mobeeli Landing.dc.html' (single-page landing, 10 sections, two 3D scenes, EN/ID i18n) and 'Join Waitlist.dc.html' (4-step seller waitlist wizard); parts-gen.html generates the 3D part sprite assets.
impact: Without the site, the Early Adaptor program cannot capture the momentum from field sales (shops signed on paper have no digital follow-up channel); the 0%-for-first-300-shops promo has no registration funnel; investor outreach lacks a credible public face; and the 2026 launch marketing has no destination URL.
current_alternatives: Manual WhatsApp and in-person sign-ups by the founders; mailto links; the pitch deck shared ad hoc. No website exists — the GitHub repo (https://github.com/piztanza/mobeeli-landing-page.git) is empty.
target_users: Indonesian auto-parts stores/sellers, garages/workshops, and distributors (waitlist audience); car owners in Jakarta (buyer notify-me audience); SEA commerce-infrastructure investors; and the founding team who receive and follow up every lead personally.
